related_questions.question: What is the 24 hour hotline for QLD health?
related_questions.snippet: Call 13HEALTH (13 43 25 84) for health information, advice or referral services. This service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. If you're unsure whether you need medical care for your symptoms, or if you feel you might require medical assessment or treatment, you can use the healthdirect symptom checker.

related_questions.question: What to do if you test positive for COVID in QLD?
related_questions.title: If you test positive for COVID-19 you should:
list: stay at home until your symptoms are gone.
monitor your symptoms – if your symptoms worsen, see your doctor.
see your doctor for oral treatments if you are in a high-risk group.
follow the advice of your state or territory health agency.

related_questions.question: How long do you have to isolate with COVID?
related_questions.snippet: “In the early days of the pandemic, it was recommended to isolate for 10 days after having a positive COVID test.
